suggested_fix.fix_text: Before executing a navigation command, explicitly check if the last visited URL in the current context is identical to the target URL. If so, instead of navigating, re-scan the entire page content (scroll down) for missed information or explicitly state that the current source has been exhausted and suggest a new search query or keyword refinement.

probe_details.notes: The error analysis is highly accurate. The trace clearly shows a 'step_repetition' error where Turn 10 is identified as the start of a loop (re-visiting the same page in Turns 13 and 14 after failing to find info in 10/12). The Planner explicitly notes the lack of progress in each step, yet the WebSurfer returns to the exact same Wikipedia link in Turn 10, repeats ThePeerage in Turn 13, and then attempts a search which turns out to be a lateral move rather than finding the answer immediately. The agent failed to persist on the new search strategy or recognize the exhaustion of the Wikipedia/ThePeerage paths effectively, leading to redundant loops. Fixing the navigation guard or prompting the agent to 'stop and evaluate' before repeating a URL would prevent this wasted time.
